messages:
Zoe Chen: Heads up-- saw a GCP marketplace invoice with two lines that look like duplicate prorations for the same subscription month. combined charge is $2,700.
Ben (finance): duplicate prorations? can you paste the lines (subscription_id + amount)?
Zoe Chen: CSV snippet: `subscription_id,usage_start,usage_end,amount\nsub-gcp-abc123,2026-03-01,2026-03-15,1350\nsub-gcp-abc123,2026-03-15,2026-03-31,1350` both labeled "prorated-monthly" but vendor also sent a monthly flat $2,700 elsewhere.
Priya Rao: sounds like double-bill: vendor sent both prorated halves and a full month. did ingestion dedupe on invoice_id?
Zoe Chen: invoice_id is INV-GCP-4521 referenced in both lines; ingestion did not flag as duplicate because lines have different usage window.
invoicing-bot: Automated: invoice INV-GCP-4521 queued; potential duplicate detected by heuristic 'line_overlap_amounts'.
Ben (finance): immediate step: open GCP billing support asking them to explain duplicate. hold reseller payout for the $2,700 until clarified. post suspense GL 2205 for now.
Priya Rao: opened case #GCP-778899 and attached the invoice pdf + ingestion log. link: https://cloud.google.com/support/cases/GCP-778899
Ben (finance): if GCP confirms it's a single billed period then we ask for corrected invoice. if they say it's valid, we'll need to issue a one-time adjustment back to reseller.
Zoe Chen: adding JIRA to improve our dedupe logic to check invoice_id + subscription_id + total_amount across windows.
Priya Rao: action items: 1) Priya follow GCP case (owner: Priya) 2) Ben hold payout + post suspense GL (owner: Ben) 3) Zoe update dedupe heuristics (owner: Zoe). target: 7 business days.
Ben (finance): acknowledged. I'll notify VP Finance only if resolution requires >$5k credit.
